The '''Governor's Mansion''' was a residence located in [[Tasariq City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Dem Keval]], lived in the mansion with his family. Offices for his [[Aide/Legends|aides]] were located on the bottom floor, and a unit of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were stationed on the premises.<ref name="J15" />
